description: Notification for the storage of hazardous substances comprising the storage and use of biogas, fuel oil, hydrogen peroxide and sodium hypochlorite on the site.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Public Statement dated February 2020, Covering letter and notices dated 04 February 2020, photograph of notice posted outside site dated 27 January 2020. Received: 05 February 2020 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The hazardous substances shall not be kept or used outside the Area Occupied as shown on the Application for Hazardous Substances Consent Location Plan - (Map tile Name: 14941 dated 22/01/2020 Printed by mhazeldi; and the Hazardous Substance Location plan: Prepared by Mel Moore-Hart July 2019)) which formed part of the application.
Condition : 4 - Hydrogen Peroxide, H2O2 must not be stored or used above 50%w/w in water.
